about.title: Litsebi tsa lithuto le mesebetsi, tse tsamaellanang le mabaka.
about.lede: E etselitsoe batho ba khathetseng ke ho tsamaisa liboto tsa generic. Kenya seo u ithutileng sona le seo u ka se etsang - re beha menyetla le ho bolela hore na ke hobane'ng ha e lekana.
about.ideaTitle: Ho bapisa ho lokela ho utloahala joalo ka kakaretso, eseng ho lahla likhokahano.
about.ideaBody1: Lienjineri tsa ho batla le liboto tsa menyetla li bonts'a molumo. Ke ka seoelo ba tsebang lengolo la hau la Mahlale a Khomphutha, litsebo tsa hau tsa React, kapa tseo u li sebelisang ho tsoa Botswana - 'me ha ho mohla ba hlalosang ho lekana.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic e boloka boemo bo le bong bo phelang 'me e tsamaisa lihlapiso le mosebetsi o bapisoang le eona. Sephetho se seng le se seng se na le lintlha, mohloli, le lebaka leo u ka le sebelisang.
about.rulesTitle: Melao e meraro eo re sa e robeng
about.p1Body: Likhato, litsebo, le naha ke mohloli oa 'nete. Lipapali li hahuoa bocha ha u li fetola.
about.p2Title: Mabaka a karete e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe
about.p2Body: Lintlha ntle le tlhaloso ke lerata. Re ngola hore na hobaneng lethathamo le lumellana - ka puo e hlakileng.
about.p3Body: Re fumana le maemo. U etsa kopo ho setsi sa semmuso sa borutehi kapa mohiri.
about.areItem1: Boithuto ba ho tseba boemo ba profil le lipapali tsa mosebetsi
about.areItem2: Malebela a Playbook a ikhethang ho bokhoni le lipheo tsa hau
about.areItem3: Boloka, qhala, 'me u bapale hape ha boemo ba hau bo fetoha
about.notItem1: Ha re fane ka lihlapiso kapa ho hira mang kapa mang
about.notItem2: Ha re fane ka tiisetso ea kamohelo kapa lichelete
about.notItem3: Kamehla netefatsa linako tse behiloeng lethathamong la semmuso
about.studioTitle: E hahiloe ke Meetso ea Futurify
about.studioBody: Opportunistic™ ke sehlahisoa sa Futurify Designs - se etselitsoe ho ikutloa se nepahetse, se khutsitse ebile se na le thuso, eseng joalo ka boto e 'ngoe ea litempele.

about.ctaBody: Theha ak'haonte, netefatsa litsebo ho tsoa ho degree ea hau, 'me u bule maemo a tšoanang le mabaka.

onboarding.guideCountryTitle: Re lokela ho batla mesebetsi hokae?
onboarding.guideCountryTip: Khetha naha eo u batlang ho bapalla mesebetsi ho eona. Litsebi li lula lefatšeng ka bophara, ka khetho ea sebaka sa hau.
onboarding.guideCountryWhy: Mesebetsi e tlhotliloeng ke naha ena. Ho e fetola hamorao e tla itšoarella hape.
onboarding.guideYouTip: Ho hlokahala lebitso. Sehlooho sa sehlooho ke kakaretso ea mohala o le mong - joalo ka tlaleho e khuts'oane ea ho bapisa.

onboarding.guideQualsTitle: U ithutile eng kapa u fumane eng?

onboarding.guideSkillsWhy: Bokhoni bo hlahlobiloeng bo tsamaisa lipotso tsa mosebetsi le ho etsa hore mabaka a borutehi a tobe - eseng a tloaelehileng.
onboarding.guideProcessTip: Re tla notlela boemo ba hau, re batlisise, re fane ka lintlha, 'me re khutlisetse lipapiso tse fanoeng - joalo ka ho tsebisa mothusi.
onboarding.guideProcessWhy: Ha ho mefuta e meng. Ha sena se felile, dashboard ea hau e tla bula ka liphetho.

terms.title: Lipehelo tsa tšebeliso
terms.lede: Melao ea ho sebelisa Opportunistic joalo ka sebaka sa ho sibolla - eseng joalo ka mofani oa monyetla ofe kapa ofe.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic ("rona") e fana ka lihlapiso le ho bapisa mesebetsi. Leano lena le hlalosa hore na re bokella eng, hobaneng, re e boloka nako e kae, le litokelo tsa hau. Re sebelisa motheo oa boemo ba GDPR bakeng sa mosebelisi e mong le e mong lefatšeng ka bophara, 'me re hlompha melao e thata ea lehae moo e sebetsang (ho kenyeletsoa UK GDPR, POPIA naheng ea Afrika Boroa, le litlhophiso tse tšoanang). Ena ke tataiso e sebetsang ea ho latela melao bakeng sa sehlahisoa sa rona - eseng keletso ea molao ea molao sebakeng sa hau.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Ho theha ak'haonte ea hau, ho tsamaisana le ho fana ka litšebeletso tseo u li batlang
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Tšireletseho, thibelo ea tlhekefetso, botšepehi ba tšebeletso - e leka-lekaneng khahlanong le litokelo tsa hau
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Moo re tlamehang ho boloka kapa ho senola data tlas'a molao o sebetsang
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Lengolo-tsoibila le mangolo a netefatso ka Supabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Lebitso, naha, sehlooho, bio, mangolo a thuto le litsebo tseo u li kenyang
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Sehlooho, URL, mohloli, mabaka, lintlha, le ho boloka/hlakola boemo
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Li-cookie tsa tumello, li-cookies tsa seboka tse hlokahalang bakeng sa ho kena, li-analytics tsa boikhethelo haeba u li lumella
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Re sebelisa cookie ea tumello (opp_consent) ho hopola khetho ea hau ho isa ho likhoeli tse 12. Li-cookie tse hlokahalang li boloka netefatso e bolokehile. Lintho tseo u li ratang, li-analytics, le li-cookies tsa ho bapatsa li tla ka mor'a hore u kene. U ka fetola maikutlo a hau neng kapa neng.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Seboka sa Auth, tšireletso, ho boloka tumello ena
privacyBody.cookiesPreferencesDesc: Mohopolo oa UI oa boikhethelo ntle le tumello
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Tekanyo ea tšebeliso - mangolo a koetsoe ho fihlela a lumelloa
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Li-tag / tsa ho bapatsa — lingoloa li koetsoe ho fihlela li lumelloa
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: — kapa sebelisa li-setting tsa Cookie botlaseng ba leqephe.
privacyBody.useBody: Profaele ea hau e fana ka malebela a tšoanang le a ho beha mabaka. Ha re rekise data ea hau. Ha re sebelise litšoaneleho tsa hau ho theha liprofaele tsa papatso ntle le haeba u lumella ka ho hlaka hore li-cookie li bapatsoe le hore mothusi oa hau oa lipapatso a senoloe mona.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Lisebelisoa li ka sebetsana le data libakeng tse sebelisoang ke bafani ba rona (mohlala Supabase le Brevo). Moo boitsebiso bo tsoang naheng ea heno, re itšetlehile ka litšireletso tse nepahetseng tse hlokometsoeng tlas'a melao ea mokhoa oa GDPR (joalo ka melaoana e tloaelehileng ea konteraka e fanoang ke bafani bao) le ho fokotsa seo re se bolokang.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Ho lula ak'haonte le ho bapisa data ha ak'haonte ea hau e ntse e sebetsa. Haeba u hlakola lintlha tsa hau ho Litlhophiso, re tla tlosa profaele, mangolo a thuto, litsebo, litšoantšiso, le nalane ea lipatlisiso polokelong ea lisebelisoa. Ho hlakola ak'haonte ea Auth-account ho ka koptjoa ho hello@opportunistic.online. Lirekoto tsa tumello li ka bolokoa e le bopaki ba khetho ho fihlela nako ea bophelo ba cookie kapa joalo ka ha ho hlokeha ke molao.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Ho ipapisitse le hore na u lula hokae, u kanna ua ba le litokelo tsa ho fihlella, ho lokisa, ho hlakola, ho thibela, ho etsa ntho, data ea boema-kepe le ho tlosa tumello. Re hlompha tsena e le motheo oa lefats'e. U ka hlophisa boemo ba hau neng kapa neng, 'me ua hlakola lintlha tsa hau ho Litlhophiso.
privacyBody.rightsCalloutMid: → Hlakola data ea ka. Bakeng sa likopo tse ling:
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ha ea lebisoa ho bana ba ka tlase ho lilemo tse 16 (kapa lilemo tse phahameng tsa tumello ea dijithale naheng ea heno). Se ke oa theha ak'haonte haeba u le ka tlase ho lilemo tseo. Haeba re ithuta hore re tšoere data e joalo, re tla e hlakola.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Re arolelana lintlha le li-processor tse thusang ho tsamaisa litšebeletso: Supabase (auth/database), Brevo (imeile ea transaction ha e lumelletsoe), le ho amohela (our hosting providers). Mananeo a buloa libakeng tsa batho ba bang ka maano a bona. Ha re rekise data ea hau.
privacyBody.contactBody: Lipotso tsa lekunutu kapa likopo tsa litokelo:

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic ke sethala sa ho sibolla. Re hlahisa lihlapiso tsa mokha oa boraro le lethathamo la mesebetsi ho latela boemo ba hau. Ha re bafani, mohiri, kapa mofani oa monyetla ofe kapa ofe o bontšitsoeng setšeng.
termsBody.roleCallout: Kamehla u qetelle likopo lethathamong la mohloli oa semmuso. Opportunistic e hlalosa hantle; mohloli o na le tokelo le liphetho.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Mananeo a ka felloa ke nako ka mor'a indexing. Kamehla netefatsa ho tšoaneleha, linako, le mehato ea ho etsa kopo webosaeteng ea mohloli pele o etsa kopo. Lintlha tsa papali, ho beha mabaka, le malebela ke likeletso - ha se tiisetso ea kamohelo, chelete, kapa mosebetsi.
termsBody.accountAccuracyDesc: Ke uena ea ikarabellang bakeng sa bonnete ba lintlha tseo u li romellang
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Se ke oa kenya data ea motho e mong ntle le tumello
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Re ka emisa liakhaonto tse sebelisanang hampe kapa ho leka ho hlakola litšebeletso
termsBody.liabilityBody: Ho isa tekanyong e lumelletsoeng ke molao, Opportunistic ha e ikarabelle bakeng sa liqeto tse entsoeng ho ipapisitsoe le lethathamo le hlahang, ho kenyeletsoa menyetla e koetsoeng, litaba tse sa nepahalang tsa batho ba bang, kapa likopo tse sa atleheng.
termsBody.privacyAfter: e hlalosa seo re se bokellang le litokelo tsa hau. Li-cookies tsa boikhethelo le mahlale a tšoanang a tla feela ka mor'a hore u lumelle ho sebelisa banner ea li-cookie kapa litlhophiso tsa Cookie. Li-cookie tse hlokahalang bakeng sa ts'ireletso, ho kena, le ho hopola khetho eo li lula li le teng. Bona
termsBody.changesBody: Re ka ntlafatsa mantsoe ana ha sehlahisoa se ntse se fetoha. Letsatsi la Nchafatso e kaholimo ho leqephe le bonts'a ntlafatso ea morao-rao. Tšebeliso e tsoelang pele ka mor'a liphetoho e bolela hore u amohela lipehelo tse ntlafalitsoeng.

reasons.locationRemote: Karolo ea hole / lefats'e ka bophara - e ka sebetsa ho tsoa ho {{country}} haeba mohiri a lumella sebaka sa heno.

reasons.linkedinReason: Patlo ea LinkedIn e sekametse ho {{country}} ka tšimo ea hau / litsebo tsa hau joalo ka mantsoe a bohlokoa.
reasons.remoteReason: Boto ea hole-pele e tlhotliloeng ke slug ea litsebo "{{slug}}" kahoo {{country}} ha se blocker e thata.

tips.sLeadership: Ngola pale ea boetapele ba mantsoe a 150 e qalang ka {{place}} 'me e qetella ka hore na khau ea {{source}} e atisa tšusumetso eo joang.
tips.sModules: 'Mapa semelo sa {{field}} sa hau ho limmojule tse 3 lenaneong la sepheo {{location}} - bolela limmojule polelong ea hau.
tips.sEssaySkills: Moqoqong oa 1, fana ka serapa se le seng mabapi le kamoo {{skills}} e seng e hlahisitse sephetho se ka lekanyetsoang (linomoro li otla matlhaodi).
tips.sAdvanced: Etella pele ka botebo ba {{skill}} ({{level}}) e le bopaki boo u ka bo khonang {{intensity}}.
tips.sWeak: Pele o romela, phahamisa {{skill}} ka projeke e khuts'oane kapa setifikeiti - bahlahlobi ba hlokomela likopo tse sa phethoang tsa boiphihlelo.
tips.sRefereeInst: Botsa moahloli ho tsoa ho {{institution}} ea u boneng u etella pele, eseng feela ho u ruta - Liphanele tsa mokhoa oa Chevening li susumetsa boima ba limaraka feela.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Sireletsa balaoli ba babeli ba ka qotsang morero o itseng oo u o tsamaisitseng - litlhaku tse sa hlakang tsa "seithuti se sebetsang ka thata" li tebisa lintlha tse matla.
tips.sCalendar: Theha almanaka ea nako ea ho khutlisa ho tloha ho "{{deadline}}" ka li-buffers bakeng sa lingoliloeng, liteko le litšupiso.
tips.sOffline: Likarabo tse qapiloeng ka ntle ho marang-rang pele, ebe u li manamisa ka har'a portal - liphoso tsa ho ipolokela li hlakola lihora tsa mosebetsi liforomong tse ngata tsa lihlapiso.
tips.sAlumni: Patlisiso ea baithuti ba 2 ba {{place}} ba hlotseng {{source}}; hlokomela seo ditshebediso tsa bona di se totileng mme o be le seipone sa sebopeho, e seng pale.
tips.sScore: Haeba lintlha tsa hau tsa papali e le {{score}}%, tšoara likheo ka botšepehi moqoqong - liphanele li putsa ho itlhokomela ho feta lipolelo tsa phetheho.
tips.sHeadline: Lokisa sehlooho sa hau ("{{headline}}") le sepheo se boletsoeng ke lenaneo e le hore skrine ea pele e se e utloahala ka boomo.
tips.sPitch: Lokisetsa lentsoe la metsotsoana e 60 la moralo oa hau oa ho ithuta bakeng sa lipuisano: bothata → moeli oa hau → {{source}} joalo ka sekontiri.
tips.sProof: Bokella lintho tsa khale tsa bopaki (GitHub, litlaleho, likhau, mangolo a sechaba) tse tšehetsang tsebo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe eo u e thathamisitseng - li-screenshots pele u etsa kopo.
tips.sEligibility: Sheba maemo a naha le a ho khutlela hae bakeng sa {{source}} khahlano le boemo ba hau {{country}} potolohong ena - liphoso tsa ho tšoaneleha li senya mengolo e matla.
tips.sBio: Ngola bio ea hau bocha hore motho eo u sa mo tsebeng ho {{location}} a utloisise tšimo ea hau polelong e le 'ngoe, ebe o a holisa.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Khetha lithuto tse tharo tsa UK tse hlileng li lekanang {{field}}, eseng botumo feela - Chevening e hana lithuto tse tharo tse sa lumellaneng le ka litlhahlobo tse matla.
tips.sCheveningNet: Sebelisa leqephe le felletseng mabapi le merero ea "marang-rang": ke mekhatlo efe ea UK, li-labs, kapa lihlopha tsa maano tseo u tla li kopanya le seo u se khutlisetsang ho {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Sefa DAAD ka boemo ba hau ba degree le {{field}}, ebe lethathamong le lekhuts'oane la mehala ea 2 - lits'ebetso tse tloaelehileng tsa "Jeremane" ha se hangata li hlakisang sehiloeng sa pele.
tips.sDaadLang: Etsa qeto esale pele hore na o hloka bopaki ba Sejeremane kapa Senyesemane bakeng sa lenaneo la moamoheli, 'me u behe letsatsi la tlhahlobo pele mohala o koaloa.
tips.sMastercardApply: Etsa kopo ka yunivesithi e sebetsang le eona e rutang {{field}} - Mastercard Scholars e ikhethile ka khamphase, eseng mofuta o le mong oa lefats'e.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Ngola litlhoko le boetapele hammoho: serapa se le seng mabapi le litšitiso, se seng ka seo u seng u se fetotse molemong oa ba bang ho {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Sebelisa leqephe la naha ea hau la Fulbright feela - linako le liforomo tsa {{country}} li fapane le bukana ea lefats'e.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Etsa hore sepheo sa lipatlisiso/thuto e be leshano: ke potso efe ho {{field}} eo u tla e araba ka mor'a likhoeli tse 12-24?
tips.sGates: Cambridge fit e tla pele: bolela mookameli kapa sehlopha sa lab se amanang le {{field}} pele u bentša polelo ea Gates.
tips.sTheme: Kopanya tlhahiso ea hau ho sehlooho se phatlalalitsoeng ho tsoa ho {{source}}, u sebelisa puo ea mohala - ho se lumellane ha sehlooho ke ho hanoa ka khutso.
tips.jResume: Ngola kakaretso ea CV ea hau hore e etelle pele ka {{skill}} + {{field}}, ebe u bonahatsa maetsi a 5 a holimo ho tsoa ho le leng le le leng {{source}} ha u bula.
tips.jProof: Haha "leqephe la bopaki" le nang le likulo tse 3: bothata, ts'ebetso e sebelisang {{skills}}, sephetho se ka lekanyetsoang.
tips.jAdvanced: Beha {{skills}} karolong ea pele ea boraro ea LinkedIn/About - bahiri ba qhekella, ha ba tsome.
tips.jWeak: Bakeng sa mesebetsi e hlokang {{skill}}, eketsa morero o monyane oa mafelo-beke 'me u o hokahanye - likopo tsa mahareng tse se nang bopaki lia hlophisoa.
tips.jAlerts: Beha litlhokomeliso {{source}} bakeng sa "{{field}}" le naha ea heno ({{country}}), ebe u sebetsa nakong ea lihora tse 48 tsa ho romella.
tips.jTarget: Sheba lik'hamphani tse 5 ka beke tse hirang {{field}} ho tsoa kapa ho tsoa ho {{country}}, eseng ho tobetsa ho 50 ho sa reroang ho Easy Apply.
tips.jCover: Lengolong le leng le le leng la sekoaelo, bolela konkreite e le 'ngoe eo u ka e romellang matsatsing a pele a 30 u sebelisa stack ea hau ea hajoale.
tips.jReferrals: Kopa ho fetisetsoa feela ka mor'a hore u hlalose sehlahisoa sa sehlopha ka lipolelo tse 2 - serame se botsa ntle le mosebetsi oa sekolo o chesang marokho.
tips.jLoom: Rekota Loom ea metsotsoana e 90 (kapa molaetsa oa lentsoe) ha u ntse u tsamaea ka morero; e kopanye ha {{source}} e lumella molaetsa / sebelisa litlatsetso.
tips.jConfidence: Tšepo ea hau ea hajoale ea papali ke ~{{score}}% - haeba e le ka tlase ho 70%, tiisa litsebo ho Profile 'me u bapale hape pele u fafatsa lisebelisoa.
tips.jTranslate: Fetolela puo ea thuto ho tloha {{field}} ho ea puong ea mohiri: "workwork" → "hlahisa X tlas'a nako ea ho qetela".
tips.jLog: Boloka tlaleho ea ho hana: karolo, tsebo e sieo, ketso e latelang - mekhoa e u bolella seo u lokelang ho ithuta sona ka potlako ho feta ho hakanya.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Bulela Open to Work (bahiri feela) 'me u kenye projeke e bonts'ang {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Fana ka maikutlo a hau mabapi le mesebetsi e 3 ea batsamaisi ba {{field}} bekeng ena pele u sebetsa ka mokhoa o batang - ponahalo e futhumetseng e feta khutsitseng Etsa kopo.
tips.jIndeed: Sebelisa filthara ea sebaka sa Indeed hantle joalo ka "{{country}}" 'me u hlophise ka letsatsi - khale e senya matla.
tips.jRemoteOk: Bala naha/nako ea sebaka habeli linthong tsa Remote OK - likarolo tse ngata tsa "hole" li ntse li kenyelletsa {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Theko ea sekhahla sa mokonteraka oa hau le sebaka sa nako se tsamaisanang ka pele molaetseng oa pele ho qoba ho felloa ke moea ka mor'a li-skrini.
tips.jGlassdoor: Bala litlaleho tsa morao-rao tsa lipuisano bakeng sa mohiri eo, ebe u lokisetsa lipale tse 2 tse arabang lipotso tse atisang ho phetoa.
tips.jReliefImpact: Etella pele lits'ebetso tse nang le tšusumetso e matla ho {{place}} - ReliefWeb e hira boiphihlelo bo amanang le thomo.
tips.jReliefLang: Bapisa puo ho tsoa ho sekheo (MEAL, tšireletso, WASH, joalo-joalo) ha feela u ka khona ho e sireletsa - buzzword stuffing e hlakile.
tips.jHeadline: Ikamahanya le sehlooho sa hau sa sechaba ho "{{headline}}" hohle moo u sebelisang teng e le hore {{source}} skrini le CV ea hau e bue pale e le 'ngoe.
